# Load packages & datasets

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

schools_ds = read_csv("schools.xlsx - schools.csv")
inst_ds = read_csv("instLevel.xlsx - instLevel.csv")
```


# Create sports_ds

```{r}
# make one row for each gender for each sport
gender_long = schools_ds %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      PARTIC_MEN,
      PARTIC_WOMEN,
      PARTIC_COED_MEN,
      PARTIC_COED_WOMEN
    ),
    names_to = "athlete_gender",
    values_to = "n_athletes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    team_type = recode_values(
      athlete_gender,
      "PARTIC_MEN" ~ "Men",
      "PARTIC_WOMEN" ~ "Women",
      "PARTIC_COED_MEN" ~ "Coed",
      "PARTIC_COED_WOMEN" ~ "Coed"
    ),
    athlete_gender = recode_values(
      athlete_gender,
      "PARTIC_MEN" ~ "Men",
      "PARTIC_COED_MEN" ~ "Men",
      "PARTIC_WOMEN" ~ "Women",
      "PARTIC_COED_WOMEN" ~ "Women"
    ),
    Sports = recode_values(
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ paste("Men's", Sports),
      "Women" ~ paste("Women's", Sports),
      "Coed" ~ paste("Coed", Sports)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_athletes)) %>%
  mutate(
    op_exp_per_athlete = recode_values(
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ OPEXPPERPART_MEN,
      "Women" ~ OPEXPPERPART_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ OPEXPPERPART_COED_MEN
    ),
    op_exp = recode_values(
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ OPEXPPERTEAM_MEN,
      "Women" ~ OPEXPPERTEAM_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ OPEXPPERTEAM_COED_MEN
    ),
    revenue = recode_values(
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ REV_MEN,
      "Women" ~ REV_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ REV_COED_MEN
    ),
    expense = recode_values(
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ EXP_MEN,
      "Women" ~ EXP_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ EXP_COED_MEN
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-c(
    team_type,
    OPEXPPERPART_MEN, OPEXPPERTEAM_MEN,
    OPEXPPERPART_WOMEN, OPEXPPERTEAM_WOMEN,
    OPEXPPERPART_COED_MEN, OPEXPPERTEAM_COED_MEN,
    OPEXP_PART_COED_WOMEN, OPEXP_TEAM_COED_WOMEN,
    REV_MEN, REV_WOMEN, REV_COED_MEN, REV_COED_WOMEN,
    EXP_MEN, EXP_WOMEN, EXP_COED_MEN, EXP_COED_WOMEN
  ))

# pivot longer expense grouping for each sport
expense_long = gender_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      n_athletes,
      op_exp_per_athlete,
      op_exp,
      expense,
      revenue
    ),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )


# create num coaches metric/value
coach_long = gender_long %>%
  mutate(
    total_head_coaches = case_when(
      grepl("^Men's", Sports) ~ MEN_TOTAL_HEADCOACH,
      grepl("^Women's", Sports) ~ WOMEN_TOTAL_HDCOACH,
      grepl("^Coed", Sports) ~ COED_TOTAL_HDCOACH
    ),
    total_assistant_coaches = case_when(
      grepl("^Men's", Sports) ~ MEN_TOTAL_ASSTCOACH,
      grepl("^Women's", Sports) ~ WOMEN_TOTAL_ASTCOACH,
      grepl("^Coed", Sports) ~ COED_TOTAL_ASTCOACH
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -c(op_exp_per_athlete, op_exp, expense, revenue),
    total_head_coaches,
    total_assistant_coaches
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(total_head_coaches, total_assistant_coaches),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# add expense data with coach data
expense_coach_long = bind_rows(
  expense_long,
  coach_long
) %>%
mutate(
  value = case_when(
    metric %in% c("total_head_coaches", "total_assistant_coaches") ~
  replace_na(value, 0),
    .default = value
  )
) %>%
arrange(institution_name, Sports, athlete_gender) 


# select only relevant columns
sports_ds = expense_coach_long %>%
  select(unitid, institution_name, Sports, athlete_gender, metric, value) %>%
  rename("sport" = Sports)

sports_ds

```



# Create coach_ds


```{r}
# preserve the totals for validation
coach_totals = schools_ds %>%
  select(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports, MEN_TOTAL_HEADCOACH, WOMEN_TOTAL_HDCOACH, COED_TOTAL_HDCOACH, MEN_TOTAL_ASSTCOACH, WOMEN_TOTAL_ASTCOACH, COED_TOTAL_ASTCOACH, SUM_FTHDCOACH_MALE, SUM_PTHDCOACH_MALE, SUM_FTUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_PTUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_FTHDCOACH_FEM, SUM_PTHDCOACH_FEM, SUM_FTUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_PTUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_FTASCOACH_MALE, SUM_PTASCOACH_MALE, SUM_FTACUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_PTACUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_FTASCOACH_FEM, SUM_PTASCOACH_FEM, SUM_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_TOTAL_ASSTCOACH, SUM_TOTAL_HDCOACH
  )


# map the source variables to their meanings
coach_map = tribble( 
  ~athlete_gender, ~coach_role, ~coach_gender, ~team_assignment, ~assignment_var, ~employment_var,

  "Men", "Head", "Male", "Full-time", "MEN_FTHEADCOACH_MALE", "MEN_FTUNIVEMPLOY_MALE",
  "Men", "Head", "Male", "Part-time", "MEN_PTHEADCOACH_MALE", "MEN_PTUNIVEMPLOY_MALE",
  "Men", "Head", "Female", "Full-time", "MEN_FTHEADCOACH_FEM", "MEN_FTUNIVEMPLOY_FEM",
  "Men", "Head", "Female", "Part-time", "MEN_PTHEADCOACH_FEM", "MEN_PTUNIVEMPLOY_FEM",

  "Women", "Head", "Male", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTHDCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_FTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Head", "Male", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTHDCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_PTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Head", "Female", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTHDCOACH_FEM", "WOMEN_FTUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Women", "Head", "Female", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTHDCOACH_FEM", "WOMEN_PTUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Coed", "Head", "Male", "Full-time", "COED_FTHDCOACH_MALE", "COED_FTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Head", "Male", "Part-time", "COED_PTHDCOACH_MALE", "COED_PTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Head", "Female", "Full-time", "COED_FTHDCOACH_FEM", "COED_FTUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Coed", "Head", "Female", "Part-time", "COED_PTHDCOACH_FEM", "COED_PTUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Men", "Assistant", "Male", "Full-time", "MEN_FTASCOACH_MALE", "MEN_FTACUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Men", "Assistant", "Male", "Part-time", "MEN_PTASCOACH_MALE", "MEN_PTACUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Men", "Assistant", "Female", "Full-time", "MEN_FTASSTCOACH_FEM", "MEN_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Men", "Assistant", "Female", "Part-time", "MEN_PTASSTCOACH_FEM", "MEN_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Women", "Assistant", "Male", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTASCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_FTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Assistant", "Male", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTASCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_PTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Assistant", "Female", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTASTCOACH_FEM", "WOMN_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Women", "Assistant", "Female", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTASTCOACH_FEM", "WOMN_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Coed", "Assistant", "Male", "Full-time", "COED_FTASCOACH_MALE", "COED_FTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Assistant", "Male", "Part-time", "COED_PTASCOACH_MALE", "COED_PTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Assistant", "Female", "Full-time", "COED_FTASTCOACH_FEM", "COED_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Coed", "Assistant", "Female", "Part-time", "COED_PTASTCOACH_FEM", "COED_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM"
)


# expand team-assignment counts into one row per coach
coach_assignments = schools_ds %>%
  select(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    all_of(coach_map$assignment_var)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(unitid, institution_name, Sports),
    names_to = "source_variable",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    coach_map,
    by = c("source_variable" = "assignment_var")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(count), count > 0) %>%
  uncount(weights = count, .id = "coach_number")


# expand university employment counts into a separate roster
coach_employment = schools_ds %>%
  select(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    all_of(coach_map$employment_var)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(unitid, institution_name, Sports),
    names_to = "source_variable",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    coach_map,
    by = c("source_variable" = "employment_var")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(count), count > 0) %>%
  uncount(weights = count, .id = "employment_number") %>%
  group_by(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender
  ) %>%
  mutate(coach_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender,
    coach_number, university_employment = team_assignment
  )


# match the rosters and retain the totals
coach_ds = coach_assignments %>%
  group_by(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender
  ) %>%
  mutate(coach_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    coach_employment,
    by = c(
      "unitid", "institution_name", "Sports",
      "athlete_gender", "coach_role", "coach_gender",
      "coach_number"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender,
    team_assignment, university_employment,
    coach_number
  ) %>%
  rename("sport" = Sports) %>%
  arrange(institution_name, sport, athlete_gender) 

coach_ds
```
